# Neela Psychological Services

> A space for compassionate, client-centred care.
> Neela Psychological Services is a private counselling psychology practice in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, South Africa. Psychologists Khetsiwe Nkosi and Lesedi offer individual, couple, student and group therapy for adolescents, young adults, adults and couples — in person or online.

## Contact

- Address: 72 Alcade Road, Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, 0081, South Africa
- Email: Neelapsychologicalservices@gmail.com
- Phone: 076 608 1912 | 072 433 5270 | Reception +27 62 497 8206
- WhatsApp: 072 123 4566 (WhatsApp only)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00 by appointment

## Services and fees

- Standard individual session: R850 in person, R700 online, 50–60 minutes
- Standard couple session: R1 000 in person, R850 online, 60 minutes
- Student session: R650 in person, R550 online, 50 minutes
- Group sessions: R200 per person, 90 minutes, minimum 5 people

## Focus areas

Anxiety and panic, depression and low mood, burnout and work stress, trauma, grief and bereavement, relationship difficulties, self-esteem and identity, life adjustment and change.

## How to book

Send a booking request (preferred times), WhatsApp on 072 123 4566, or call 076 608 1912, 072 433 5270 or +27 62 497 8206.
